fields.Name: T362 - Component Browser Search Narrows List
fields.Description: Exercises ComponentStudioStateService's SearchQuery filter over FilteredComponents (client-side component filtering), a different code path from the generic grid quick-search.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Component Studio app (open it via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, Components section), locate the 'Search components...' box in the left browser panel. Type a few characters of a likely component name (or a random string like 'zzz'). Verify the browser RESPONDS: the 'X of Y' count updates and the card list narrows to matches, OR a 'No matching components' empty state appears for a non-matching query. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. The feature working (list reacts to the search term) is success regardless of how many components the seed data contains.

judgeValidationCriteria: Typing in the 'Search components...' box changes the visible component list and/or the 'X of Y' count
A non-matching query produces a 'No matching components' empty state rather than an unchanged full list
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
